configurationGaps.name: Add exact local callback URI
completionCriteria: No wildcard, tunnel, LAN, preview, or arbitrary-port URI is added.
Post-change redirect list is captured in redacted evidence.

configurationGaps.name: Resolve Ross External/Testing eligibility
completionCriteria: Ross is eligible to complete the OAuth flow while the app remains Testing.
Committed evidence records eligibility result only.
Full account identifier is not committed.

configurationGaps.name: Review two enabled secret rows
completionCriteria: Secret-slot count is reviewed immediately before rotation.
Old/new handling is identified by non-secret metadata such as creation timestamp.
No secret value or masked ending is recorded.

configurationGaps.name: Create or update ignored local issuer configuration
completionCriteria: Ignored local issuer configuration exists only after a later authorized mission.
Provider client ID match is verified privately without printing values.

configurationGaps.name: Confirm consent scopes
completionCriteria: Operator-visible or browser-proof evidence confirms expected OIDC scopes only.
Any unexpected scope blocks browser proof pending review.

configurationGaps.name: Review production-style redirect
completionCriteria: Production-style redirect is classified as deployment-planned, retained with reason, or scheduled for separate approved removal.

configurationGaps.name: Review production-style JavaScript origin
completionCriteria: Production-style origin is classified as deployment-planned, retained with reason, or scheduled for separate approved removal.

configurationGaps.name: OAuth secret rotation
completionCriteria: Remains unperformed until redirect, eligibility, slot handling, and local ignored configuration prerequisites are complete.

configurationGaps.name: Browser OAuth proof
completionCriteria: Remains unperformed until provider corrections are complete and S007.01J or equivalent browser-proof mission is explicitly authorized.

requiredCorrectionOrder: Review production-style redirect and JavaScript origin.
Review two enabled secret rows and define old/new handling.
Create or update ignored local issuer configuration only in a later authorized mission.
Proceed to controlled rotation and browser proof only after correction evidence passes.
browserProofPrerequisites: Ignored local issuer configuration exists and privately matches authoritative client ID.
Issuer started only by authorized browser-proof mission.
Login alone does not authorize writes.
secretRotationPrerequisites: Provider redirect configuration supports local proof.
Provider behavior and slot capacity confirmed immediately before action.
Rollback preserves a working prior secret until replacement proof passes.
No secret value is printed, screenshotted, committed, or pasted into chat.

providerConfiguration: Capture pre-change provider metadata in redacted form.
Apply only approved correction in a later execution mission.
If local proof plan still fails before secret rotation, revert only the non-secret provider configuration change that caused the failure.
Do not touch client secrets during configuration rollback.
secretRotation: Keep a working prior secret enabled until replacement proof succeeds if provider behavior allows.
If two enabled rows block replacement creation, stop for Ross approval of row handling.
Never commit secret values, masked endings, tokens, cookies, JWTs, authorization codes, or sensitive screenshots.

evidenceRequiredForCertification: consent user type and publishing status
Ross eligibility result without full account identifier
secret-slot count and creation timestamps without values or masked endings
